Definition: from G3617; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.
BiblicalUsage: Oikodespoteo means to guide the house, to rule the household as its head. It occurs once, in 1 Timothy 5:14, where Paul says the younger women should marry, bear children, and guide the house, giving no occasion to the adversary.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe guiding the house is a holy work, and the home well ruled gives the adversary nothing to speak against.
